biographical_milestones.event: Sentenced to Life Imprisonment at Rivonia Trial
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Convicted of sabotage and transferred to Robben Island.

biographical_milestones.event: Release from Victor Verster Prison after 27 Years
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Historic walk to freedom initiating end of apartheid.

biographical_milestones.event: Inauguration as First Black President of South Africa
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Sworn in following first universal democratic elections.

biographical_milestones.event: Demise from Respiratory Infection at Houghton
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Passed away peacefully surrounded by family.
